title: cfs footer
description: A navy footer band: a centred light call to action, a row of a monospace 'follow' label, orange social icons, a short rule and a ring-arrow link, then a hairline and four columns (a large orange mark, address and legal lines, labelled contact emails, and site links) in monospace with orange underlines that turn white on hover. Everything centres and stacks on phones.
notes: a `dark` subtree on the theme's card colour (navy in cfs-theme)
the mark and the social icons are props (lucide icons in the demo)
name: cfs-footer

props.name: call
props.description: the big centred call to action

props.name: followLabel
props.description: the label before the social icons, e.g. "Follow us"

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: social links: an icon each, with an accessible label

props.name: cta

props.name: mark
props.description: the large mark in the first column (an icon or logo, ~105px)

props.description: company name and address, one line each

props.name: contacts
props.description: labelled contacts in the third column

props.name: links
